forecastPolicy: Do not invent numeric revenue or conversion uplift when observed sales, PV, clicks, purchases, acquisitions or install data are absent. Use ranked opportunities and explicit measurement gates until measurable signals exist.

rankedOpportunities.basis: The app is prepared to a high quality level but lacks Partner Center product identity/submission. Completing the live Store funnel is the prerequisite for acquisition, install, conversion and later listing experiment data.

The initial six free articles are now reader-visible verified, but first-party PV/engagement/click/purchase data are still unavailable and the first 24h equal-age window has not matured. The next valuable step is measurement, not speculative CTA or price churn.

Future paid articles can improve purchase qualification without price changes by ensuring the free area contains empathy/question framing, a concrete change or example, and a clear reader benefit before the paywall.

Bundle and upsell structures may raise order value, but current product-level sales evidence is unavailable. Prepare only strongly coherent bundles and defer live pricing changes until demand is observed.
Existing public pages can become attribution surfaces once a verified measurable destination exists. Do not add unverified or unrelated CTA stacks.

nightlyDecision.reason: Availability is verified, but article-level and product-level demand/conversion baselines are still missing. The earliest current free-note publications have not yet completed a 24h comparable window.
